prompt_partition_name_deviation.note: The task prompt names partitions 'cpu' and 'gpu'. THOSE DO NOT EXIST on this cluster. `srun --partition=cpu true` => 'error: invalid partition specified: cpu'. Documented mapping used everywhere downstream:

cpu_partition.name: cpu-ops
cpu_partition.evidence: srun --partition=cpu-ops hostname => job 2308 allocated, ran on cpuops-t560-proxmox, rc=0; srun --partition=cpu-ops true => rc=0

gpu_partition.name: gpu-orangefs
gpu_partition.evidence: srun --partition=gpu-orangefs --gres=gpu:1 nvidia-smi -L => 'GPU 0: NVIDIA L4 (UUID: GPU-b3ffdfa8-b165-5562-f443-f40daaeef893)', rc=0; srun --partition=gpu-orangefs --gres=gpu:1 true => rc=0

filesystem_topology.critical_finding: The login/control node (this container) mounts /workspace on /dev/rbd4 (Ceph RBD). The compute nodes DO NOT see /workspace at all (srun chdir to /workspace/* fails -> falls back to /tmp). The compute nodes mount /orangefs/training (OrangeFS, pvfs2 tcp://10.100.100.2:3334) which the control node does NOT see. There is NO common shared path.
filesystem_topology.staging_strategy: sbcast (available at /usr/bin/sbcast) is REQUIRED to stage the souc binary + .sio sources + data CSVs onto compute-node local storage; results are returned to the control node via captured job stdout (sgather is not installed).

toolchain.souc_kind: mini_native (usage: souc <source.sio> <output>; compiles .sio to a native x86_64 ELF). NOTE: the 243MB artifacts/omega/souc-bin/souc-linux-x86_64 is a Rust INTERPRETER (crates/souc/src/interp/eval.rs) and panics on intended u64 wraparound in lcg_step ('attempt to multiply with overflow') — not usable for this numeric path. The native bin/souc is the path A3 used historically.

acceptance.requirement: >=1 CPU partition AND >=1 GPU partition ALLOCATABLE (srun true rc=0 on each)
caveats: Partition names deviate from prompt (cpu->cpu-ops, gpu->gpu-orangefs); documented, not silently substituted.

STEP 0 PASS proves the partitions are allocatable and the GPU is an NVIDIA L4. It does NOT by itself prove native-.sio numeric execution works under Slurm — that requires sbcast staging (see filesystem_topology) and is validated separately.
